memories.title: Public API backward compatibility window
memories.body: The public API must remain backward compatible for the next two releases. This is required because deployed clients update on a quarterly schedule, and breaking changes before that window would strand them.
memories.why: Client update schedules are outside our control; breaking changes early would strand quarterly-updating clients.
memories.source_quote: Keep the public API backward compatible for the next two releases. Our deployed clients update quarterly, so breaking the API early would strand those clients.
